name: GameModeDispatch
DebugMenuHandler
comment:
DebugMenuHandler -- gameMode 7 handler (gameModeHandlerTable[7]). Loads cdFileLocTable[11] ->
0x800CEDF8 via CdReadRequest, then inits (FUN_80011778, FUN_80015310). = the TCRF L3 debug menu
(retail: only room-select works). Entered by forcing gameMode=7 (padState 0x80078DC2 is the
cheat's L3 condition, NOT a game read). Phase 3 T8.

name: LzssDecodeSector
comment: LZSS streaming decompressor (PAC type-4 overlays). Resumable 5-state machine; consumes input in 0x800-byte CD-sector chunks. Ring window = lzss_ringBuffer @ 0x1F800000 (scratchpad, 1024B). State var lzss_state (0x800C7D24) indexes LzssStateTable (0x80072A30). Match: absolute 10-bit ring index, -1 bias; pos==0 terminates. Source: AiroRom wiki MIPS listing, byte-verified vs local US SLUS-00726 EXE (memory-map §2.1, confidence=verified).

name: LoaderInitFileTable
comment:
LoaderInitFileTable -- file-loader directory resolver (called once at boot @0x800101fc).
Searches \DEBUG.BIN;1 -> debugBinPresent (0x800747d0); resolves 21 CdPathTable[0x80062C24]
entries (stride 0x30 = {name[0x14]; CdlFILE}) via CdSearchFile; reads LIST.CD (0xE40 B) via
CdReadRequest -> listCdBuffer (0x80180000); builds cdFileLocTable (0x800AE830: CdlLOC+size per
sub-file) over the 8 .CD files (MAIN, SC01-SC07). Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T2 (verified).

name: CdReadRequest
comment:
CdReadRequest(CdlFILE *src, void *dest, int size, int mode) -- read-request dispatcher.
Gated by CdQueueBusy (0=idle, else refuse). Dedups on cdReq_curSector (*src). Stashes the
request into the control block (cdReq_dest/size/cdlFile/mode) and drives CdReadStateMachine.
Returns cdReq_result. Callers: LoaderInitFileTable + 5 file-load API sites
(0x80010ca4,0x80010f1c,0x80011100,0x80011178,0x800112f0). Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T2 (verified).

name: CdReadStateMachine
comment:
CdReadStateMachine -- polled async CD reader (switch on cdReq_state). Hand-rolled low-level
sequence: CdControl(0x0E CdlSetmode=0xA0) -> CdControl(0x15 CdlSeekL)+CdPosToInt ->
CdControl(0x06 CdlReadN)+CdReadyCallback(CdReadSectorReadyCB @0x8001a338) -> CdControl(0x09
CdlPause)+CdSync/CdFlush. Sector drain via CdGetSector inside the ready-callback. The game does
NOT use PsyQ CdRead()/CdReadSync(). Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T2 (verified).

name: CdReadSectorReadyCB
comment:
CdReadSectorReadyCB -- CdReadyCallback for CdReadStateMachine (registered in its case 5). Drains CD
sectors via CdGetSector and dispatches per file type: RAW -> FUN_8002fc64 (memcpy 0x800 B to
cdReq_sink 0x800AE728); LZSS -> CdGetSector into lzss_sectorStagingBuf (0x80079A70) then
LzssDecodeSector (0x80018730) inline, per sector. Decrements cdReq_wordsRemaining (0x800AE748).
This is the ONLY caller of LzssDecodeSector. Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T2/T4 (verified).

name: ResourceLoadStateMachine
comment:
ResourceLoadStateMachine -- loads a resource by id (resLoad_curId) via resourceIdMap (0x80063138).
Load-once cache (resLoad_lastId / resLoad_loadedFileIdx). If field0 < 0 (0xFFFF) -> non-CD path
FUN_80036d58(field1). Else: ResourceGetCdLoc -> cdReq_curSector; FUN_800363cc(field1,
&cdFileLocTable[idx], 0x10) streams the load; FUN_8002d4c8(field2, 0) post-processes. Polled on
resLoad_state; done flag resLoad_result. Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T3 (verified).

name: ResourceGetCdLoc
comment:
ResourceGetCdLoc(short id) -> CdlLOC (int). Two-level lookup:
resourceIdMap[id].field0 (= cdFileLocTable index) -> cdFileLocTable[idx].pos.
Caller: ResourceLoadStateMachine. Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T3 (verified).

name: SaveLoadRoutine
comment:
SaveLoadRoutine -- save/load handler referenced by saveHeaderTemplate (0x80072DF0 ptrs
0x8002B154/0x8002B1AC/0x8002BEA4). Dispatch branches on (selector & 7). Entry point to the
PS1 memcard save-data format (Q#5); full data-block format still TBD. Phase 3 T8.

name: StreamLoadStateMachine
comment:
StreamLoadStateMachine (FUN_800363cc) -- second CD loader, DISTINCT from CdReadStateMachine. 0x12-state
machine (streamLoad_state 0x8006AF00) with its own CdReadyCallback LAB_800377d8
(streamLoad_savedReadyCB / streamLoad_cbActive). Issues CdControl SetMode(0xA0)/SeekL(0x15)/ReadN(0x06)
with retry + CdMode handling. Driven by ResourceLoadStateMachine(field1, &cdFileLocTable[idx], 0x10).
Exact role (overlay loader vs real-time stream) -> T5. Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T4 (fn id
verified; full semantics partial).

CdPathTable: CD-path string table, 23 entries x 0x30-byte stride (0x80062C24..~0x8006307x). Order: \LIST.CD, \MAIN.CD, \SC01..\SC07.CD, STR movies (ST01-06, SHOPS01, OPEN, END, OUT; ST04/ST05 each twice), \MUSA.ID (0x80063014), \DEBUG.BIN (0x80063044). NOTE: \DEBUG.BIN;1 is a GHOST (absent from retail ISO) => surviving debug-loader path references it (xref anchor, T2/T8). LOGOA/LOGOB.STR and .DA files are NOT in this table (referenced elsewhere, TBD). Source: local EXE scan 2026-06-10, confidence=verified.
GHOST path: \DEBUG.BIN;1 is absent from the retail ISO; the code that references this string is the surviving debug loader (prime xref anchor for the debug menu / DEBUG.BIN reachability, T8).

resourceIdMap -- resource-ID -> file map, stride 6 bytes = three u16:
  +0 field0 = cdFileLocTable index (0xFFFF = special / non-CD resource)
  +2 field1 = loadParam (overlay/dest slot; arg to FUN_800363cc / FUN_80036d58)
  +4 field2 = procParam (post-load; arg to FUN_8002d4c8; 0 = none)
Indexed by resLoad_curId. field0*8 indexes cdFileLocTable (0x800AE830: {CdlLOC pos; u32 size}).
Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T3 (verified).

LzssStateTable: u32 00000000, u32 FFFFFFFF, then 5 state entry pointers [state0 finish=0x80018824, state1 init=0x80018790, state2 checkBit=0x800187a4, state3 match=0x800187f8, state4 nextBit=0x800188b4]. Content-verified vs memory-map ledger. Indexed by lzss_state.

loadDestPtrTable -- table of load DESTINATION addresses (5 entries, runtime-indexed; null-terminated):
  [0] 0x800CEDF8 = resident blob base (= JP 0x800CDF58 + 0xEA0; the dest of all 5 boot-file loads via
      CdReadRequest at 0x80010CA4/0F1C/1100/1178/12F0 -- they read entry[0] @ offset 0x2c70)
  [1] 0x80128158 = location script overlay base (JP 0x80128508 analogue; spans AP-world US patch
      sites 0x8013xxxx-0x8018xxxx and high boss-HP 0x8018EE00..0x801F8714)
  [2] 0x800CAE08, [3] 0x800CCB1C, [4] 0x800C7F08 = resident-region blobs
Addresses are EXE-constant load dests (static-verified as constants); their semantic ROLES + runtime
layout are HEURISTIC pending the T6b live RAM-dump proof. Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T5.
WRITE-ONLY (set by LoaderInitFileTable @0x8001979C, never read) -> the \DEBUG.BIN;1 loader path is DEAD in retail. Resolves Q#9. (T8)
REPORTED (confidence=reported; AP-world): zone-loaded + portal-destination control block. JP delta -0xE70. VERIFY.
REPORTED (confidence=reported; TCRF GameShark D0078DC2 0200): pad-state halfword; 0x0200 = L3. Distinct from 0x80078DCA (do NOT conflate). VERIFY.

lzss_sectorStagingBuf -- US LZSS input staging buffer (0x800 B = 1 CD sector). CdReadSectorReadyCB
fills it via CdGetSector(buf, 0x200 words) then calls LzssDecodeSector(0x80079A70) to decode inline.
JP analogue 0x80078BD0 (+0xEA0 delta); now BYTE-VERIFIED from US code (was heuristic in memory-map
S3.2). Provenance: static trace, Phase 3 T4 (verified).

REPORTED (confidence=reported; TCRF debug code + AP-world): game-mode / main-menu flag. Writing 7 here while pad==0x0200 (L3) enters the debug menu. JP=0x800B8B3E (US-0xEA0). VERIFY in Ghidra/emulator before relying.

REPORTED (confidence=reported; 3 sources: autosplitter + AP-world + gamehacking): current location/map id (s16). ~0x1010 town, 0x2018 interiors, 0x3000+ dungeons. Central to overlay loading (T5/T6). VERIFY before relying.
